summary: HBT Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share, payable May 19, 2026 to holders of record on May 12, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return plan, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is reported. The filing is purely an ordinary dividend announcement.
